project_context.positioning: We build customer acquisition systems that help local businesses attract, convert, and track new customers.
project_context.target_audience: Local service businesses (HVAC, landscapers, contractors, roofers, painters, home service).
project_context.goal: Convert local business owners into booked consultations.

typography.rules: Avoid Inter/Space Grotesk. Optimize for premium SaaS aesthetic with authoritative geometric headings and high-legibility body text.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-mono font-bold text-blue-500
hierarchy.quote: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-light italic text-slate-200 border-l-2 border-blue-500 pl-4

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/40 with 1px border-white/5 for navbars, sticky headers, and floating overlays. Never use completely transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Keep shadows deep and minimal. Use shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.4)] for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px inner strokes (border-white/10) to separate components from dark backgrounds. Avoid thick borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle noise/grain texture overlaid at 2% opacity to break digital flatness.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section dividers. Internal component padding should be p-8 to p-12.
layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid protocol for feature cards. Mix 3+ shapes (e.g., span-8, span-4, tall lists).
layouts.container: Max width 1280px (max-w-7xl) with px-6 or px-8 side padding.

responsive.breakpoint_strategy: Mobile-first approach. All complex grids stack vertically (grid-cols-1) on mobile.
responsive.typography_scaling: Fluid or clamped scaling. H1 goes from text-4xl (mobile) to text-6xl (desktop).
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure overflow-x-hidden on the main wrapper. Pad containers to prevent edge-hugging.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px for buttons and calendar selectors.

motion.hero: Kinetic Hero with staggered line-by-line text reveal (y: 20, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1, stagger: 0.1s).
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for industry logos or core pillars. 30s-40s duration, seamless loop.
motion.scroll_reveal: Fade up with slight y-translate (y: 30px) hooked to ScrollTrigger/useInView for sections.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and cards should scale up slightly (scale: 1.02) and increase border opacity. Use pure CSS transitions (duration-300 ease-out) for basic hovers, Framer Motion for complex.

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.style: Crystal Glass style. Sticky top, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B1020]/70 border-b border-white/5.
components.behavior: Visible logo, 4 central links, prominent 'Book Audit' button on right.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.style: Electric blue background (bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600) with white text. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or subtle 8px radius. Include a right-pointing arrow icon.

components.name: Consultation Booking Calendar
components.style: Dark-mode Shadcn Calendar with custom blue-500 active states. Clean layout. Integrated time slot picker (styled as toggleable grid buttons).

components.name: Industry Bento Cards
components.style: Aceternity 'Tracing Beam' or dark gradient borders. Deep #12182B background with 1px border-white/5.

sections: Hero: Kinetic text + Parallax dark dashboard 3D visualization.
Marquee: 'Trusted by over 500 local service professionals'.
Problem Manifesto: 'Stop Guessing Start Growing' - Numbered layout.
System: 5-step Growth System using a vertical timeline or staggered grid.
Who We Help: Bento grid of industry cards (HVAC, Roofers, etc.).
Differentiators: 'What Makes Us Different' - Abstract UI cards.
Pricing Philosophy: Clean text section with Coral accent CTA.
Testimonials: Slider or masonry grid of client reviews.
FAQ: Accordion (Shadcn) styled with minimal borders.
Content: Two-column layout. Left: Trust markers & info. Right: Embedded Calendar + Time Picker + Lead Form.

Neon geometric lines forming a digital landscape. Use as background overlay or decorative element.
HVAC technician working. Use in 'Who We Help' industry cards.
Smiling contractor. Use in Testimonials or 'Who We Help' segment.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text over #0B1020 has a minimum 7:1 ratio. Muted text (#64748B) must meet 4.5:1 ratio over deep backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: All inputs and buttons must have a high-contrast focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-400 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling parallax and staggering for affected users.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns) must include `data-testid`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read the JSON payload thoroughly. Execute a strict dark-mode-first aesthetic with deep navy (#0B1020) and near-black (#050816) base colors.
Do not implement generic Vercel/Stripe looking components; push boundaries using Aceternity-inspired tracing beams and glassmorphism.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling and Framer Motion for the kinetic line-by-line hero reveal and scroll-triggered fade-ups.
Typography MUST be swapped from default Inter to Cabinet Grotesk (Heading), Manrope (Body), and JetBrains Mono (Code/Numbers).
Mobile-first responsive rule: Ensure complex bento grids start out as single columns on mobile devices to avoid overflow and cramping.
For the Contact page, implement a highly functional Booking Calendar using Shadcn Calendar combined with custom time-slot chips.
Images provided in `image_urls` must be utilized in their respective categories. Do not use placeholder images.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all functional elements.
Avoid making completely transparent headers or overlays when content scrolls beneath.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid simplistic gradients and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Never center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Preserve natural reading flow.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add hover states, transitions, and entrance animations to all interactive elements.
